## Verdict: **CONDITIONAL GO** for personal production use

The application code, tests, release integrity and host hardening are in good shape: no critical or high **code** defect was found, all local and hosted quality gates pass for the reviewed commit, the deployed bytes match the tag, the private database is separated from the demo, secrets are handled correctly, and the 2026-09-28 backup was restored and verified in isolation.

The GO is conditional because the private deployment is **not yet operating as a personal tool**:

1. **REL-01 — No private user exists** (`users = 0`). The dashboard cannot be entered on production. _Condition:_ operator provisions one user with `workspace_id` set (runbook step), then completes the target-host smoke (login → queue → detail → enrichment on a designated synthetic record → feedback → reload → logout → 401).
2. **REL-02 — Mailbox intake is disabled** since 2026-09-22; no alerts have been ingested for ~7 days. _Condition:_ either re-enable intake following the mailbox runbook (connectivity check → controlled poll → health) or record the disabled state explicitly in the roadmap.
3. **REL-03 — No recurring backup.** A single manual dump exists. _Condition:_ establish a scheduled dump (or confirm provider snapshots) before relying on the tool day-to-day.

Recommended but not conditions: SEC-01 (logout blocked for unassigned users), REL-04 (live `.env`/`storage` physically inside the retained rollback directory), SEC-03/SEC-04 (security headers, log level), and the legacy scaffold clean-up (LEG-01…03).

## Scope and coverage

**Inspected in full:** `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, roadmap, project sheet (all five phases), ADR-004/005/007/008, the three requested runbooks plus `phase2-compatibility-check.md` (referenced), `portfolio.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` (targeted sections); all 83 first-party PHP files under `app/`; `routes/`, `bootstrap/`, all 13 `config/` files; all 16 project migrations, factories and seeders; all Vue/Blade/CSS/JS sources; `scripts/*.mjs`; both workflows and `dependabot.yml`; `composer.json`/`.lock`, `package.json`/`.lock` (declared vs. locked versions), `phpunit.xml`, `phpstan.neon.dist`, `playwright.config.js`, `compose.yaml`, `.env*.example`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `.npmrc`; all 40 test files (bodies read for auth, mailbox, release, browser suites; others by name and targeted excerpts). Two focused sub-reviews (mailbox pipeline; frontend/seeder/release tooling) were performed and their line-cited findings were spot-verified.

**Reviewed by manifest/inventory only (not read):** `vendor/` (30 top-level packages, `composer audit --locked`), `node_modules/` (`npm audit`), the published CycloneDX SBOM, compiled `public/build` assets (manifest + hash only), the six `.eml` fixtures (privacy already covered by prior bounded review), the ~38 kB inline style block in the dead `welcome.blade.php`.

**Not inspectable / unavailable:** hosting-panel settings (PHP-FPM pool per subdomain, WAF rules producing 466/509, TLS termination), provider database snapshots, the personal profile contents and any private opportunity content (deliberately not read), gitleaks locally (hosted `Secret scan` reused).

## Privacy statement

No credentials, hostnames of the private site, database names, personal profile values, opportunity titles/descriptions/notes, message identifiers or backup row contents were printed during the audit or written into these reports. The backup was streamed into an isolated loopback-only database without touching local disk and dropped after verification.
